note: Full triage was done directly on the 288 new unique top-20 headlines across the 8 reachable outlets (ynet, n12, haaretz, walla, themarker, kan, i24; israelhayom/ch14/makorrishon/calcalist remained blocked from this runner per CLAUDE.md). Only the in-scope/ambiguous/excluded subset worth flagging is itemized above for auditability; the remaining ~270 headlines (politics, war/security coverage, crime, celebrity, lifestyle, sports, weather) were triaged 'no' - no citable-source empirical claim - and are not itemized individually. 12 stories were selected for audit, preferring cross-outlet clusters and higher homepage ranks; one single-outlet first-publication investigative claim (Hamas aid-truck revenue) was kept in scope since it makes a specific empirical claim checkable against UN/COGAT reporting, even though its primary attribution is the outlet's own investigation rather than an external study.
